description:
The ideal candidate will be comfortable architecting new functionality in Sitecore, integrating front-end code into .NET, and working amongst a team of like-minded developers. 
Must have experience with C#/ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, LESS, AJAX, XML, SQL, PHP, Visual Studio, SQL Server Studio, Team Development for Sitecore, Git, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office, Fiddler, and MongoDB. 
Desired experience of JSON, XML and related notational data representations and a Sitecore certification is ideal.
